frame_row: Coordinate directory lookup, ownership decisions, victim replacement, tagged two-phase probes and commit/abort for multiple in-flight cache lines.

label: u_vlsit_riscv_coh_bank_arb
(m_vlsit_riscv_coh_bank_arb)
blocks.function: Select eligible directory work fairly within each of four independent banks while preserving request identity.

label: u_vlsit_riscv_coh_txn_table
(m_vlsit_riscv_coh_txn_table)
blocks.function: Own the lifetime and immutable identity of every active coherence transaction and its current probe phase.

label: u_vlsit_riscv_probe_scheduler
(m_vlsit_riscv_probe_scheduler)
blocks.function: Schedule one active tagged probe per cache and route matching cache responses to the correct context.

label: u_vlsit_riscv_sharer_directory
(m_vlsit_riscv_sharer_directory)
blocks.function: Store a conservative set of L1 holders and MESI/owner metadata independently of shared LLC residency.
